parsed.title: Discussion on AI-driven job search, development acceleration, and code quality

claims.text: Automating job search with a cloud setup that generates PDF resumes and cover letters is considered useful.
OpenClaw is planned to be configured for vacancy finding, resume generation, and cover‑letter writing.
Developers need to acquire AI‑related skills (Cursor, Claude Code, LLM, RAG, embeddings) to avoid being filtered out by recruiters.
Keyword‑based candidate search is increasingly detached from reality.
It is expected that the recruiting profession will become obsolete.

topics.title: AI accelerating development and associated pitfalls

claims.text: Since 2025 AI tools have dramatically accelerated development, though the tools are becoming absurdly expensive.
LLMs can generate SQL joins and other boilerplate code, speeding up routine development tasks.
Their projects have no cloud components and will never adopt cloud infrastructure.
Lowering the entry barrier with cloud services leads to poorly optimized and insecure code, such as massive auto‑generated SQL queries.
Incremental computations were replaced by a view, effectively burying them.
Database schema changes trigger automatic recreation of the whole database, causing operational challenges.
The described setup resembles REST, JSON, microservices, and Docker after React.

decisions.text: The team will not adopt cloud infrastructure for their projects.
AI‑generated feature code was discarded after review because it lacked adequate quality.
